note: Declarative contract and manual-review input; not an executed test suite.

cases.given: one invocation names more than one project or component scope

expect.action: ask the user to select exactly one scope

cases.given: /analyze-project is invoked in a scope with one primary real entry

expect.need: one normal call from the primary entry to its main observable result, earliest result-changing branch, and existing verification entry

cases.given: /analyze-project is invoked where no unique primary entry or observable behavior can be identified

expect.question: Which observable behavior should this report explain?

cases.given: /analyze-project ./learn and ./learn is an existing directory
/analyze-project ./develop and ./develop is an existing directory
/analyze-project ./learn learn and ./learn is an existing directory
/analyze-project bin/csl-agent-kit.js develop --need explain why learn wins
/analyze-project bin/csl-agent-kit.js --need

expect.question: What current implementation question should this report answer?

cases.given: /analyze-project src/a src/b

expect.action: ask the user to choose one scope

cases.given: the canonical Git root is analyzed in either focus
directory src/scheduler is analyzed in either focus
file bin/csl-agent-kit.js is analyzed in either focus
directory foo, extensionless file foo, files foo.js and foo.ts all exist
a component name has multiple candidates or target contains independent Git roots

expect.action: ask the user to select one scope

cases.given: the target or derived output escapes through a symlink or cannot be represented safely
the active report target is a symlink, directory, device, or other non-regular file
a regular active report already exists
an old active report has Scope, HEAD, Working tree, and Generated at but no valid unique Need
the user selects Cancel for an existing active report
the user confirms Replace
a matching historical report exists under docs/analysis/learning

expect.notice: Legacy report retained at <path>; archival only.

cases.given: clean, dirty, and unborn repositories are analyzed

expect.unborn_statement: This report is based on uncommitted working-tree content and does not represent a revision.

the target was absent but link(temp, target) returns EEXIST
the confirmed target identity, byte length, or SHA-256 changes before rename
